en.title: Scrap Garden and the Paper Corpse
en.premise: In a world where digital archives have vanished and physical 'paper' is the only thing of value, I am a scavenger. One day, I stumble upon a 'cherry blossom seed' encased in a mysterious bio-capsule, along with a fragmented map leading to an old bookstore. With a battered scanner running on a mere 30% battery, I set out on a journey to make bloom the 'pink despair' thought to be extinct. This is the story of a foul-mouthed girl taking the most useless, yet most luxurious gamble of her life.

zh.title: 废料花园与纸之尸
zh.premise: 这是一个数字档案已然消亡、物理意义上的“纸张”成为唯一价值的世界。身为回收员的我，某天捡到了装在神秘生物胶囊里的“樱花种子”，以及一张通往旧书店的残缺地图。带着电量仅剩30%的破旧探测器，我踏上了旅程，只为让那本该已经灭绝的“粉色绝望”再次绽放。这是一个毒舌的我，赌上人生中最徒劳却又最奢侈的一场豪赌的故事。
